info.name: CP Standing API
info.description: Complete API collection for Competitive Programming Standing System

request.description:
## Overview

Check if the server is running and healthy.

## Returns

- Simple status message
- Server health status

## Usage

Use this endpoint to verify your server connection before making other API calls.

## Overview

Create a new training session.

## Required Fields

- `title` (string) - Training title
- `level` (enum) - One of: `Beginner`, `Intermediate`, `Advanced`
- `startDate` (ISO date string) - Start date in ISO format

## Optional Fields

- `type` (enum) - Either `training` or `camp` (defaults to `training`)
  - **Note:** Camp type uses different penalty calculation

## Returns

- Created training object with populated `sheets`, `contests`, and `trainees` arrays

## Overview

Retrieve all training sessions.

## Returns

- Array of all trainings
- Sorted by `startDate` (newest first)
- Each training includes populated:
  - `sheets`
  - `contests`
  - `trainees`

## Usage

Use this to get a list of all available trainings.

## Overview

Get a specific training by its MongoDB ObjectID.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID (replace with actual MongoDB ObjectID)

## Returns

- Training object with all populated relationships:
  - `sheets`
  - `contests`
  - `trainees`
- **404** if training not found

## Overview

Filter trainings by difficulty level.

## Parameters

- `:level` - One of:
  - `Beginner`
  - `Intermediate`
  - `Advanced`

## Returns

- All trainings matching the specified level
- Sorted by `startDate` (newest first)

## Usage

Useful for filtering trainings by difficulty.

## Overview

Update an existing training.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID

## Request Body

Send only the fields you want to update (all optional):

- `title` (string)
- `level` (enum)
- `type` (enum)
- `startDate` (ISO date string)

## Important Notes

- Changing `type` from `training` to `camp` will affect penalty calculations
- Only send fields you want to update

## Returns

- Updated training object

## Overview

Permanently delete a training session.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID

## Warning

⚠️ **This action cannot be undone.**

## Returns

- Success message if deleted
- **404** if training not found

## Note

This does **not** delete associated:
- Sheets
- Contests
- Trainees

Only removes the training record.

## Overview

Add an existing sheet to a training session.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID

## Request Body

```json
{
  "sheetId": "SHEET_ID_HERE"
}
```

## Requirements

- Sheet must exist in the database
- If sheet is already added, it won't be duplicated

## Returns

- Updated training with populated `sheets` array

## Overview

Get details of a specific sheet within a training.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID
- `:sheetId` - Sheet ID

## Returns

- Sheet object if it exists in the training
- **404** if:
  - Training not found
  - Sheet not found
  - Sheet is not part of this training

## Overview

Remove a sheet from a training session.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID
- `:sheetId` - Sheet ID

## Note

This only removes the **association** - the sheet itself is **not** deleted.

## Returns

- Updated training object with remaining sheets

## Overview

Add an existing contest to a training session.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID

## Request Body

```json
{
  "contestId": "CONTEST_ID_HERE"
}
```

## Requirements

- Contest must exist in the database
- If already added, it won't be duplicated

## Returns

- Updated training with populated `contests` array

## Overview

Get details of a specific contest within a training.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID
- `:contestId` - Contest ID

## Returns

- Contest object if it exists in the training
- **404** if:
  - Training not found
  - Contest not found
  - Contest is not part of this training

## Overview

Remove a contest from a training session.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID
- `:contestId` - Contest ID

## Note

This only removes the **association** - the contest itself is **not** deleted.

## Returns

- Updated training object with remaining contests

## Overview

Add a single trainee to a training session.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID

## Request Body

```json
{
  "traineeId": "TRAINEE_ID_HERE"
}
```

## Requirements

- Trainee must exist in the database
- If already added, it won't be duplicated

## Returns

- Updated training with populated `trainees` array

## Overview

Add multiple trainees to a training session at once.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID

## Request Body

```json
{
  "traineeIds": [
    "TRAINEE_ID_1",
    "TRAINEE_ID_2",
    "TRAINEE_ID_3"
  ]
}
```

## Requirements

- All trainee IDs must exist in the database

## Returns

- Detailed results showing:
  - Which trainees were added
  - Which already existed

## Benefits

✅ More efficient than adding trainees one by one

item.name: Add Trainees by Handles to Training

request.description:
## Overview

Add trainees to a training using their Codeforces handles instead of IDs.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID

## Request Body

```json
{
  "handles": [
    "handle1",
    "handle2",
    "handle3"
  ]
}
```

## Requirements

- Trainees must exist in the database with matching handles

## Returns

- Results showing:
  - Added trainees
  - Already existing ones
  - Handles not found

## Usage

Useful when you know handles but not IDs.

item.name: Add Trainees by Coach to Training

request.description:
## Overview

Add all trainees belonging to a specific coach to a training session.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID

## Request Body

```json
{
  "coach": "Coach Name"
}
```

## How It Works

- Finds all trainees with matching `coach` field
- Adds them to the training

## Returns

- Results showing:
  - How many were added
  - How many already existed

## Usage

Useful for adding entire groups at once.

## Overview

Remove a trainee from a training session.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Training ID
- `:traineeId` - Trainee ID

## Note

This only removes the **association** - the trainee itself is **not** deleted.

## Returns

- Updated training object with remaining trainees

## Overview

Create a new trainee record.

## Required Fields

- `name` (string) - Trainee name
- `handle` (string) - Codeforces handle (must be unique)
- `titlePhoto` (string) - URL to title photo

## Optional Fields

- `coach` (string) - Coach name
- `rating` (number) - Codeforces rating (defaults to 0)
- `color` (string) - Auto-calculated from rating

## Important

⚠️ The `handle` must be **unique** - duplicate handles will cause an error.

## Returns

- Created trainee object

## Overview

Retrieve all trainees in the system.

## Returns

- Array of all trainee records with:
  - Name
  - Handle
  - Rating
  - Coach
  - Performance data

## Usage

Use this to get a complete list of all registered trainees.

## Overview

Get a specific trainee by their MongoDB ObjectID.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Trainee ID (replace with actual MongoDB ObjectID)

## Returns

- Complete trainee object including:
  - All performance records
  - Personal details
- **404** if trainee not found

## Overview

Get a trainee by their Codeforces handle.

## Parameters

- `:handle` - Trainee's Codeforces handle (case-insensitive)

## Returns

- Trainee object
- **404** if not found

## Usage

Useful when you know the handle but not the ID.

## Overview

Get all trainees assigned to a specific coach.

## Parameters

- `:coach` - Coach name

## Returns

- Array of all trainees with matching `coach` field

## Usage

Useful for filtering trainees by their coach.

## Overview

Update an existing trainee's information.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Trainee ID

## Request Body

Send only the fields you want to update (all optional):

- `name` (string)
- `handle` (string)
- `titlePhoto` (string)
- `coach` (string)
- `rating` (number)

## Auto-Update

- Updating `rating` will automatically update the `color` field

## Returns

- Updated trainee object

## Overview

Permanently delete a trainee record.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Trainee ID

## Warning

⚠️ **This action cannot be undone** and will remove:
- All associated performance data
- All training associations

## Returns

- Success message if deleted
- **404** if trainee not found

## Overview

Add a performance record for a trainee.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Trainee ID

## Request Body

```json
{
  "itemId": "SHEET_OR_CONTEST_ID",
  "itemType": "Sheet",
  "problemsSolved": 5,
  "points": 80
}
```

## Required Fields

- `itemId` - Sheet or Contest ID
- `itemType` - Either `Sheet` or `Contest`
- `problemsSolved` (number) - Number of problems solved
- `points` (number) - Points earned

## Purpose

Tracks how many problems the trainee solved and points earned in a specific sheet or contest.

## Overview

Update an existing performance record.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Trainee ID
- `:performanceId` - Performance record ID

## Request Body

Send only fields to update:

```json
{
  "problemsSolved": 7,
  "points": 90
}
```

## Returns

- Updated performance record

## Overview

Import multiple trainees from Codeforces handles.

## Request Body

```json
{
  "handles": [
    "handle1",
    "handle2",
    "handle3"
  ],
  "coach": "Optional Coach Name"
}
```

## How It Works

The system:
1. Fetches trainee data from Codeforces API:
   - Name
   - Rating
   - Title photo
2. Creates trainee records

## Returns

- Results showing:
  - Successfully imported trainees
  - Any errors

## Requirements

- Handles must be valid Codeforces handles

## Overview

Sync all trainees' data from Codeforces.

## What It Updates

- Rating
- Color
- Other Codeforces-related fields

## Performance

⏱️ This may take a while if you have many trainees.

## Returns

- Summary of sync results

## Usage

Useful for keeping trainee ratings up-to-date.

## Overview

Sync trainee data from Codeforces for all trainees belonging to a specific coach.

## Parameters

- `:coach` - Coach name

## What It Updates

- Rating
- Color

## Benefits

✅ More efficient than syncing all trainees when you only need to update a specific group.

## Overview

Sync trainee data from Codeforces for all trainees enrolled in a specific training.

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID

## What It Updates

- Rating
- Color

## Usage

Useful for keeping training participant data current.

## Overview

Create a new contest record.

## Required Fields

- `title` (string) - Contest title
- `duration` (number) - Duration in minutes

## Optional Fields

- `cfContestId` (string) - Codeforces contest ID
- `problems` (array) - Array of problem objects:
  ```json
  {
    "name": "1234A",
    "alpha": "A"
  }
  ```

## Note

Problems can be added later.

## Returns

- Created contest object

## Overview

Retrieve all contests in the system.

## Returns

- Array of all contest records with their problems

## Usage

Use this to get a complete list of available contests.

## Overview

Get a specific contest by its MongoDB ObjectID.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Contest ID (replace with actual MongoDB ObjectID)

## Returns

- Contest object with all problems
- **404** if contest not found

## Overview

Update an existing contest.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Contest ID

## Request Body

Send only the fields you want to update (all optional):

- `title` (string)
- `duration` (number)
- `cfContestId` (string)

## Note

Problems should be managed separately.

## Returns

- Updated contest object

## Overview

Permanently delete a contest.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Contest ID

## Warning

⚠️ **This action cannot be undone.**

## Returns

- Success message if deleted
- **404** if contest not found

## Note

Removing contest from trainings does **not** delete the contest itself.

## Overview

Add a problem to an existing contest.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Contest ID

## Request Body

```json
{
  "name": "1234C",
  "alpha": "C"
}
```

## Required Fields

- `name` (string) - Problem name, e.g., `1234C`
- `alpha` (string) - Problem index, e.g., `C`

## Returns

- Updated contest with the new problem added

## Overview

Remove a problem from a contest.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Contest ID
- `:problemId` - Problem's MongoDB ObjectID (found in the problems array)

## Returns

- Updated contest without the removed problem

## Overview

Import multiple contests from Codeforces.

## Request Body

```json
{
  "contestIds": ["1234", "5678", "9012"]
}
```

## How It Works

The system:
1. Fetches contest data and problems from Codeforces API
2. Creates contest records

## Returns

- Results showing:
  - Successfully imported contests
  - Any errors

## Requirements

- Contest IDs must be valid Codeforces contest IDs (as strings)

## Overview

Preview contest data from Codeforces before importing.

## Request Body

```json
{
  "contestIds": ["1234", "5678"]
}
```

## Returns

- Contest information without creating records:
  - Title
  - Problems
  - Duration

## Usage

Use this to verify contest data before bulk importing.

## Overview

Import a single contest from Codeforces.

## Request Body

```json
{
  "contestId": "1234"
}
```

## How It Works

1. Fetches contest data and problems
2. Creates a contest record

## Returns

- Created contest object

## Usage

Useful for importing one contest at a time.

## Overview

Sync contest problems from Codeforces.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Contest ID

## Requirements

- Contest must have a valid `cfContestId`

## How It Works

1. Fetches current problems from Codeforces
2. Updates the contest's problems list

## Usage

Useful for keeping contest problems up-to-date.

## Overview

Create a new sheet (practice problem set).

## Required Fields

- `title` (string) - Sheet title
- `duration` (number) - Duration in minutes

## Optional Fields

- `cfContestId` (string) - Codeforces contest ID
- `problems` (array) - Array of problem objects:
  ```json
  {
    "name": "1234A",
    "alpha": "A"
  }
  ```

## Note

- Sheets are similar to contests but used for **practice**
- Problems can be added later

## Returns

- Created sheet object

## Overview

Retrieve all sheets in the system.

## Returns

- Array of all sheet records with their problems

## Usage

Use this to get a complete list of available practice sheets.

## Overview

Get a specific sheet by its MongoDB ObjectID.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Sheet ID (replace with actual MongoDB ObjectID)

## Returns

- Sheet object with all problems
- **404** if sheet not found

## Overview

Update an existing sheet.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Sheet ID

## Request Body

Send only the fields you want to update (all optional):

- `title` (string)
- `duration` (number)
- `cfContestId` (string)

## Note

Problems should be managed separately.

## Returns

- Updated sheet object

## Overview

Permanently delete a sheet.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Sheet ID

## Warning

⚠️ **This action cannot be undone.**

## Returns

- Success message if deleted
- **404** if sheet not found

## Note

Removing sheet from trainings does **not** delete the sheet itself.

## Overview

Add a problem to an existing sheet.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Sheet ID

## Request Body

```json
{
  "name": "1234C",
  "alpha": "C"
}
```

## Required Fields

- `name` (string) - Problem name, e.g., `1234C`
- `alpha` (string) - Problem index, e.g., `C`

## Returns

- Updated sheet with the new problem added

## Overview

Remove a problem from a sheet.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Sheet ID
- `:problemId` - Problem's MongoDB ObjectID (found in the problems array)

## Returns

- Updated sheet without the removed problem

## Overview

Import multiple Codeforces contests as sheets (practice problem sets).

## Request Body

```json
{
  "contestIds": ["1234", "5678", "9012"]
}
```

## How It Works

- Creates **sheet records** instead of contest records
- Useful for converting contests into practice sheets

## Returns

- Results showing successfully imported sheets

## Overview

Preview contest data from Codeforces before importing as sheets.

## Request Body

```json
{
  "contestIds": ["1234", "5678"]
}
```

## Returns

- Contest information without creating records

## Usage

Use this to verify data before bulk importing as sheets.

## Overview

Sync sheet problems from Codeforces.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Sheet ID

## Requirements

- Sheet must have a valid `cfContestId`

## How It Works

1. Fetches current problems from Codeforces
2. Updates the sheet's problems list

## Usage

Useful for keeping sheet problems up-to-date.

## Overview

Get overall standings for a training session.

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID

## Returns

Standings aggregated across all sheets and contests in the training:

- Total solved problems
- Points
- Penalties

## Sorting

Standings are sorted by:
1. Solved count (descending)
2. Penalty (ascending)

## Important Notes

- For **camp type** trainings, penalties use camp calculation
- Data is cached for performance

## Overview

Get filtered overall standings for a training.

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID

## Query Parameters (All Optional)

- `coach` - Filter by coach name
- `minRating` - Minimum rating filter
- `maxRating` - Maximum rating filter

## Returns

- Standings only for trainees matching the filters

## Usage

Useful for viewing standings for specific groups or rating ranges.

## Overview

Get a summary of training standings (statistics only, no detailed breakdown).

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID

## Returns

For each trainee:

- Total solved problems
- Total points
- Percentage

**Note:** No per-item details included

## Benefits

✅ Faster than full standings when you only need summary statistics

## Overview

Get standings for a specific sheet within a training.

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID
- `:sheetId` - Sheet ID

## Returns

Standings showing for each trainee:

- Problems solved
- Rank
- Points
- Penalty

## Data Source

- Standings are fetched from Codeforces if the sheet has a `cfContestId`
- Data is cached for performance

## Overview

Get standings for a specific contest within a training.

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID
- `:contestId` - Contest ID

## Returns

Standings showing for each trainee:

- Rank
- Solved problems
- Points
- Penalty

## Data Source

- Standings are fetched from Codeforces if the contest has a `cfContestId`
- Data is cached for performance

## Important Notes

- For **camp type** trainings, penalties use camp calculation

## Overview

Sync a trainee's data from Codeforces.

## Parameters

- `:id` - Trainee ID

## What It Updates

- Rating
- Color
- Other Codeforces-related fields

## Usage

Useful for keeping individual trainee data current without syncing all trainees.

## Overview

Manually update a trainee's performance for a specific sheet.

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID
- `:sheetId` - Sheet ID
- `:traineeId` - Trainee ID

## How It Works

1. Fetches latest standings from Codeforces
2. Updates the trainee's performance data for that sheet

## Usage

Useful for refreshing individual trainee data.

## Overview

Manually update a trainee's performance for a specific contest.

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID
- `:contestId` - Contest ID
- `:traineeId` - Trainee ID

## How It Works

1. Fetches latest standings from Codeforces
2. Updates the trainee's performance data for that contest

## Usage

Useful for refreshing individual trainee data.

## Overview

Update performance data for all trainees in a training for a specific sheet.

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID
- `:sheetId` - Sheet ID

## How It Works

1. Fetches latest standings from Codeforces for all trainees
2. Updates their performance
3. Clears and refreshes the cache for this sheet

## Benefits

✅ More efficient than updating trainees individually

## Overview

Update performance data for all trainees in a training for a specific contest.

## Parameters

- `:trainingId` - Training ID
- `:contestId` - Contest ID

## How It Works

1. Fetches latest standings from Codeforces for all trainees
2. Updates their performance
3. Clears and refreshes the cache for this contest

## Benefits

✅ More efficient than updating trainees individually
